name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: A flexible timeline for chronological events, with vertical/horizontal orientations, an alternating variant, RTL support and completed/active/pending states.

name: status
title: Status
description: A status badge with an animated ping indicator and five colour variants for system states, user presence and service health.

name: direction-provider
title: Direction Provider
description: Provides bidirectional text support (RTL/LTR) across your application, with a reader that falls back to the nearest DOM dir attribute when no provider is present.

name: pending
title: Pending
description: A utility that disables interactions, keeps keyboard focus and wires the correct ARIA state for buttons, forms, links, switches and any interactive element while it is pending.

name: stat
title: Stat
description: A card for a key metric — label, value, colour-themed indicator, trend, separator and description — laid out on a two-column grid that positions its parts by slot.

name: swap
title: Swap
description: A component that swaps between two states with click or hover activation modes.

name: color-swatch
title: Color Swatch
description: A color swatch component for displaying color values with support for transparency and various sizes.

name: circular-progress
title: Circular Progress
description: A circular progress indicator that displays completion progress in a ring format with support for indeterminate states.

name: gauge
title: Gauge
description: A circular meter that displays a value along a configurable arc, with support for custom angles, sizes and an indeterminate state.

name: badge-overflow
title: Badge Overflow
description: A component that intelligently manages badge overflow by measuring available space and displaying only what fits with an overflow indicator.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: An animated scrolling component that continuously moves content horizontally or vertically.

name: scroller
title: Scroller
description: A scrollable container with customizable scroll shadows and navigation buttons.

name: masonry
title: Masonry
description: A responsive masonry layout component for displaying items in a grid.

name: banner
title: Banner
description: A notification banner that appears at the top or bottom of the viewport. Supports queuing, priority, and auto-dismiss.

name: relative-time-card
title: Relative Time Card
description: A hover card that displays relative time relative to local time with timezone information.

name: speed-dial
title: Speed Dial
description: A floating action button that reveals a set of actions when triggered.

name: checkbox-group
title: Checkbox Group
description: A group of checkboxes that allows multiple selections with support for validation and accessibility.

name: segmented-input
title: Segmented Input
description: A group of connected input fields that appear as a single segmented visual unit.

name: mask-input
title: Mask Input
description: An input that formats what you type against a pattern like a phone number, date, credit card or currency amount.

name: phone-input
title: Phone Input
description: A phone number input with country detection, international formatting and a searchable country picker.
